Messages.Author: Chick Lewis

Dear Elethros, generally accepted belief is that the VTES versions
have updated text including much of the errata generated in the years
since Jyhad publication, therefore the VTES text overrides the Jyhad.
However, you sound like a rules lawyer to me (or at least a rules
paralegal) so whatever you can annoy and harass your local players
into accepting will fly, until they stop inviting you to the games.

Chick...@msn.com
